items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Do you see the difference, Mr. Roussel?

ctx.x: Yeah, it was the medical system. Do you see the difference, Mr. Roussel? The road hand on the bell. Do you see the difference in that,

Liz Buffett and my Buffett? I don't know. No, I don't remember. Why? I don't know. I've never had yours in my hand very much. Once you see it, it's all right. Does this have more keys than yours? No, I say oh my. Do you see it? No. It's straight, a little piece like a... Oh, sure, yeah.
